Registered accounts are also accepted, which keeps the auth API\\n# usable for callers that create their own actors.\\nmodule PlayAuthentication\\n  FIXED_ACTOR_ROLES = {\\n    \\\"dm\\\" => \\\"dm\\\",\\n    \\\"player\\\" => \\\"player\\\",\\n    \\\"player-a\\\" => \\\"player\\\",\\n    \\\"player-b\\\" => \\\"player\\\",\\n    \\\"stranger\\\" => \\\"player\\\"\\n  }.freeze\\n\\n  private\\n\\n  def current_play_actor\\n    authorization = request.authorization\\n    match = /\\\\ABearer session-([a-z0-9_-]{2,32})\\\\z/.match(authorization.to_s)\\n    return nil unless match\\n\\n    # Rack exposes the Authorization header as ASCII-8BIT.
